# Skewlux (skewlux.dev)
> Skewlux is a zero-backend browser performance, human-input latency, and gaming/typing diagnostic suite built by Mohammad Junaid. All reaction time, CPS polling, typing speed, and mouse sensitivity calculations run 100% locally in the browser with sub-millisecond precision.

## Core Interactive Tools
- [Skewlux Telemetry & Reaction Lab](https://skewlux.dev/): Visual & auditory reflex timer, display Hz monitor, and input latency command deck.
- [CPS & Mouse Polling Rate Test](https://skewlux.dev/cps-polling-test): Measure clicks-per-second (CPS) burst speed and mouse USB polling rate (Hz) consistency.
- [Typing Speed & WPM Test](https://skewlux.dev/typing-test): Real-time WPM, accuracy, and keystroke latency benchmark.
- [100 Words Typing Test](https://skewlux.dev/100-words-typing-test): Sprint typing speed challenge measuring raw WPM over 100 words.
- [Viral Typing Challenge](https://skewlux.dev/viral-typing-challenge): High-intensity competitive typing benchmark.
- [FPS Mouse Sensitivity Converter](https://skewlux.dev/sensitivity-converter): Convert eDPI, cm/360, and crosshair sensitivity accurately across FPS games.
